hints.title: Bipolar Parity Transformation
hints.text: Replace occurrences of the target element with +1 and all other elements with -1.

hints.title: Positive Sum Equivalence
hints.text: A subarray possesses the target as strict majority if and only if its transformed sum is strictly positive.

hints.title: Running Subarray Evaluation
hints.text: Accumulate transformed values across candidate contiguous spans and count positive sums.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Quadratic running sum evaluation on transformed +/-1 values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Frequency recounting per subarray costs O(N^3).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform majority condition to positive subarray sum.
